British Honduras.notes: Full chain found in 1966 edition covering Superintendents (1786-1857), Lieutenant-Governors (1862-1884), and Governors (1884-1961). Existing chain covers 1866-1909 (118 entries from 1910 edition). Extracting entries with year > 1909. The 1966 edition includes the earlier Superintendent era not in the existing chain, but per instructions only extracting entries beyond the existing endpoint. Also includes Sir John Paul as Governor-designate in the civil establishment section (line 384).
